text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(I'm gonna do this!! Right here, right 
now, with everything I've got!! At 
absolute full throttle!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oooooooooohhhhhhhhyyyaaaaaaaahhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Bamboo Memory!! Taking the lead 
is Bamboo Memory!! Bamboo Memory crosses 
the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*, *gasp*, *whew*— *pant*... 
*pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Heh, heheh... I-I actually... did... 
it...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Bamboo-san!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Look out!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Th-Thanks, Yaeno.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Are you all right!? Did you get hurt 
anywhere—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm... fine... Just feels like... I've 
pushed past my limits a bit――

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Truly, that was a magnificent run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ogurii!! That was so close!! You'll win 
next time!! Keep fighting!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You were amaziiing!! I'll definitely cheer 
for you in your next race, tooo!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
She really is... incredible, su...! Even 
though she just gave it her all in a 
fierce race, she's already standing so 
tall and proud...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —Bamboo Memory.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Senpai—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Your running was truly incredible. It felt 
so hot I thought I'd get burned... It 
fired me up too. That was a great race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll win. Let's run together 
again.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...! Without fail, next time...!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Well then—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Whyâ

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Why were you able to fearlessly challenge 
Oguri-san and defeat her today...?"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Faced with that same immense and 
unfathomable power... I was made painfully 
aware of the difference in our strength... 
of my own powerlessness... And yet—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Surely... it's precisely because they 
were so vast and formidable... that I was 
able to win today.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm grateful to Oguri-senpai for standing 
before me as such an impossibly high wall, 
'ssu!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Because I was desperately trying to climb 
over that wall, struggling, and wanting to 
win with everything I had—that's why I was 
able to surpass my own limits today."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's thanks to Oguri-senpai that I was 
able to grow so much bigger and stronger 
compared to before I ran in races, ya 
know!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's why Oguri-senpai isn't someone who 
devours dreams. If anything—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"She makes my challenges... my 
'dreams'...! She makes me shine even 
brighter! She's the strongest, most 
awesome Umamusume out there!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So that is where the difference 
lay between you and me up until today...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Somewhere along the way, I might have 
forgotten. The mindset one must hold when 
challenging the "strong"—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Bamboo-san. Do you think I can do it 
too?"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"To challenge the 'strong' head-on—just 
like you."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Of course I can do it...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Because challenging the 'strong' to 
elevate yourself... That's what you taught 
me, Yaeno!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much, Bamboo-san.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I wish to reclaim my original resolve, 
challenge the "strong" once more, and 
forge ahead.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Toward my... "dream"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Yaeno-san, your expression looks much 
brighter now! I'm so glad...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Having witnessed Bamboo-san's splendid 
run, she must have felt the same way we 
did.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...A power that strives toward a "dream" 
more straightforwardly than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo-san is really the kind of Umamusume 
who gives courage to other people's 
"dreams"...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. I truly think so, too—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And when we returned to the academy. 
Bamboo Memory, who had been quieter than 
usual on the way back, suddenly stopped in 
her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Your running was truly incredible. It felt 
so hot I thought I'd get burned... It 
fired me up too. That was a great race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll win. Let's run together 
again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Tear drops)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh? What is it—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, wait, what?! W-W-W-What in the 
world is thisss?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hold on a second! I'm okay, really... 
I'm totally fine...!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm fine, seriously...!! It's just,

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm just, ah…… I'm just so happy……!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
To finally, truly compete against her... 
against Senior Oguri with everything I had 
in a GⅠ race—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm just so haaaappy...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, large tears began spilling one 
after another from Bamboo Memory's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was the quietest, yet fiercest passion 
she had ever shown—a burst of pure fury.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's definitely her. From the very 
beginning until now, she's been my 
destiny...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"The greatest rival, and the greatest 
showdown." At the center of my dream, 
after all, is Oguri-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer, that's why I—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I want to become the best rival for "Oguri 
Cap."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"I can't be celebrating after just one 
victory! I need to get stronger and fight 
again and again!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
To Oguri-senpai! And to everyone! That 
'Bamboo Memory is Oguri Cap's greatest 
rival'!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna become the kind of me!! That can 
make everyone feel that way...!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer! For our next race, please let 
it be the Sprinters Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So I'm definitely gonna become the 
strongest sprinter ever! An even, even 
more awesome version of me, worthy of 
being Oguri-senpai's rival...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory's passionate feelings, 
strong enough to bring tears to my own 
eyes, were received loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then—now it's my turn as her Trainer to 
deliver! To turn her from here on out into 
"Oguri Cap's ultimate rival"...!
choice_data_list:
Before that, let's enter the Takarazuka 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Medium distance...!?
choice_data_list:
I think it's going to be a tough battle. 
But—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But...?
choice_data_list: Yaeno and Chiyono O appear in that one.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It won't just be Yaeno Muteki and her 
rivals. Other powerhouses of the 
generation will show up too. That is the 
Grand Prix race known as the Takarazuka 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory has spent time with peers 
like Yaeno Muteki, fueling the fire of her 
"dream."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, fighting with everything we 
have here, in a race where the 'dreams' of 
our generation gather—"
choice_data_list:
It's definitely going to make you 
stronger!

It's definitely going to make you 
stronger!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Yes!! My next race has gotta be the 
Takarazuka Kinen! Please let me run it!!
